p: This branch sits on the main shopping stretch of Bearwood Road, a long high street on the Smethwick and Birmingham border known for its mix of food shops, supermarkets, takeaways and restaurants from all over the world. It's an adult gaming centre, open to over 18s only.

If you're hungry, you're in the right place: walk the length of the road and you'll find everything from bakeries to curry houses. For fresh air, Warley Woods is a short walk away, a community-run park with woodland, open grassland and a café, and Lightwoods Park isn't far either. Buses run regularly into Birmingham city centre, which is only a few miles away.
